text: Few transfer sagas in English football were as dramatic as the battle for John Obi Mikel.
In 2005, the teenage midfielder was widely believed to be heading to Manchester United F.C.
after the club announced they had reached an agreement with Norwegian side Lyn Fotball.
But the story took a stunning turn. Mikel later claimed he had been pressured into that deal
and insisted he actually wanted to join Chelsea F.C. instead.
What followed was months of legal battles, accusations, and negotiations involving both clubs and football authorities.
Eventually, a compromise was reached in 2006. Chelsea secured Mikel’s signature, paying compensation to both Lyn and Manchester United. For Alex Ferguson, it was a rare transfer defeat
